# Defined Sonic integer arithmetic

Source-only successor that includes both normal-input signed-shift repairs and the legal full-scale saturating accumulation repair in Sonic C. The U8 centered value is multiplied by 256, so negative values remain defined. Both sinc interpolation products are promoted to long long before multiplication, summed and multiplied by two, divided with the original signed truncation toward zero, then converted to int. The interpolation sum is accumulated in long long and compared to INT_MIN/MAX before the existing short saturation. An explicit floor division by 65536 preserves the old target arithmetic-right-shift rounding for negative non-clipped samples. The unused sign helper and wrap counter are removed. The table, filter taps, public interface and sonic.h remain unchanged.

Apply this component before audio_haptic_sync_id (client/server queue successor), whose external Sonic guard requires the exact final C SHA. `apply.sh --source-root /absolute/openharmony` accepts only the exact complete original or final C, with an exact read-only sonic.h guard. `--preflight` never writes. `--require-patched` requires the final state and never writes. The original532 final C, any partial repair, foreign bytes, missing/aliased/nonregular sources or changed header are rejected. Repeating apply is idempotent; the parent owns the source lease and all build/package wiring.

The complete actual Sonic C was checked under ASan/UBSan with sanitizer recovery disabled. A current complete AudioSpeed snapshot supplies five-format integration; external PCM conversion/logging are explicit host dependency models. The normal format/channel/speed/pitch matrix, full-scale public-API cases, exact rational coefficients, and complete phase output vs 128-bit and defined-wrap references pass. Only final536 C is executed; old abort baselines are not replayed. These checks do not establish final528 acceptance, target ABI, actual IPC/shared memory, hardware or representative-image behavior. Future HEAD, source-kit and package remain null; all runtime/frame-zero/onset/matrix gates remain false.
